ff518dbe6f696903bc5b0116b91f3ab1fd2358d4.sourceText: 【亚利桑那州斯科茨代尔讯】3月6日晚，由国际交流组织 Global Ties Arizona 举办的第三届农历新年庆典在 Western Spirit: Scottsdale’s Museum of the West 隆重举行。来自不同国家和文化背景的嘉宾齐聚一堂，共同庆祝这一具有东方传统特色的节日。
ff518dbe6f696903bc5b0116b91f3ab1fd2358d4.translatedText: [Scottsdale, Arizona] On the evening of March 6, the third Lunar New Year celebration organized by the international exchange organization Global Ties Arizona was held grandly at Western Spirit: Scottsdale’s Museum of the West. Guests from different countries and cultural backgrounds gathered together to celebrate this festival with oriental traditional characteristics.

e2f5e46c4a54c2321bb4db247d8234951aac0ff8.sourceText: 活动现场洋溢着浓厚的中国农历新年氛围。晚会以中国舞蹈《好日子》热闹开场，随后精彩节目轮番上演。舞狮表演气势热烈，赢得观众阵阵掌声；华人画家 范融先生 现场挥毫作画，以马为主题展示中国水墨艺术；具有两千多年历史的中国传统乐器 古筝独奏 悠扬动听。此外，越南舞蹈与歌曲表演也为晚会增添了多元文化色彩。华裔侨领 Barry 担任整场活动主持人，使晚会气氛热烈而融洽。
e2f5e46c4a54c2321bb4db247d8234951aac0ff8.translatedText: The event site was filled with a strong Chinese New Year atmosphere. The party started lively with the Chinese dance "Good Day", followed by exciting performances. The lion dance performance was enthusiastic and won rounds of applause from the audience; the Chinese painter Mr. Fan Rong painted on the spot, using horses as the theme to show Chinese ink art; the guzheng, a traditional Chinese musical instrument with a history of more than 2,000 years, played a melodious solo. In addition, Vietnamese dance and song performances also added a multicultural touch to the party. Barry, a Chinese-American leader, served as the host of the entire event, making the party atmosphere warm and harmonious.

8ee1e0e22d62195a85a760b11b296ae5e050c2bf.sourceText: 华人画家 范融先生 现场挥毫作画
8ee1e0e22d62195a85a760b11b296ae5e050c2bf.translatedText: Chinese painter Mr. Fan Rong painted on the spot

fe27e0c683d6d797d45d3496476937a1172cdfe5.sourceText: 在节目之外，来宾还可以体验中国书法，将自己的名字写成中文作为纪念。主办方还准备了家庭式晚宴和甜点，让嘉宾在轻松愉快的氛围中交流互动。
fe27e0c683d6d797d45d3496476937a1172cdfe5.translatedText: In addition to the program, guests can also experience Chinese calligraphy and write their names in Chinese as a souvenir. The organizers also prepared a family-style dinner and desserts to allow guests to interact in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.

53e76e1c4f9bb4c067743529884f69f6d881e4f5.sourceText: Global Ties Arizona 是亚利桑那州致力于推动国际交流与民间外交的非营利组织，通过国际访问项目、文化交流和社区活动促进亚利桑那与世界各国之间的理解与合作。该机构拥有近60年的历史，长期接待来自世界各地的国际代表团，并组织各类跨文化活动，帮助当地社区更好地了解全球文化与事务。
53e76e1c4f9bb4c067743529884f69f6d881e4f5.translatedText: Global Ties Arizona is a non-profit organization in Arizona dedicated to promoting international exchanges and people-to-people diplomacy, promoting understanding and cooperation between Arizona and other countries around the world through international visit programs, cultural exchanges and community activities. The institution has a history of nearly 60 years. It has long received international delegations from all over the world and organized various cross-cultural activities to help local communities better understand global culture and affairs.

72efbdd11bbf3ac50102ea1dc53e6e141350b1d7.sourceText: 此次农历新年庆典不仅展示了中国传统文化，也体现了凤凰城地区多元文化交融的活力，成为促进不同文化交流与友谊的一场精彩盛会。
72efbdd11bbf3ac50102ea1dc53e6e141350b1d7.translatedText: This Lunar New Year celebration not only showcases Chinese traditional culture, but also reflects the vitality of multicultural integration in the Phoenix area, becoming a wonderful event that promotes exchanges and friendship between different cultures.
